ratings.caveat: n=1 night. The real fix was disabling the outdoor-weather ambient fallback, which was swinging water ~32 levels at a constant target; this band is secondary.
ratings.correction: v1 (64.0/65.5/66.5) was derived from the CONTROLLER TARGET scale, which does NOT discriminate: target read 66.9F during the best 160-min unbroken stretch AND at most disruptions. The water LEVEL discriminates cleanly.
ratings.correction_reason: The superseded band excluded 69 F, the water temperature its own evidence records as this user's best sleep (160 min unbroken). With it in force on 2026-08-27 the commanded water sat at 64-67 F all night, pinned at the floor for two thirds of maintenance ticks across 16 wake events, and pre-emption could not warm above 67 F. Re-centred on the measured best-sleep temperature with ~3 F clearance from both recorded awakening zones (cold 63-64 F, warm 70-72 F).
